# Quorum

**Proof first.** A live panel of four AIs runs on 0G decentralized compute and argues a real tokenized-US-stock catalyst end to end: Bull builds the case for, Bear builds the case against, Risk sets the stop, and a Judge issues the single order-triggering decision. The losing side is preserved on every verdict, in plain language. Run it yourself at https://quorum-ten-mauve.vercel.app/app (pick a catalyst, press Run live, watch the debate stream in about 20 seconds).

## The problem

Most "AI trading" demos are a single model emitting a confident answer with no counter-argument and no record of how often it was right. A trader cannot operate on that: they get the call but never the best reason the call is wrong, and never an honest hit-rate.

## What Quorum does

Quorum is a research console a trader operates, not a reel they watch:

- **Pick a catalyst, run the real panel live.** The Bull/Bear/Risk analysts reason in parallel over the same evidence packet, then the Judge rules. The order is placed through the Bitget Agent Hub SDK (paper/advisory for spot-only rTokens, never a fabricated fill).
- **Test the judging.** A conviction-gate slider re-derives the decision in pure code from the stored raw Judge output. Drag it and the call flips NO_TRADE / SHORT / LONG instantly, with a flip-point marker. No re-run, no spinner: it is arithmetic on a stored number, and the UI says so.
- **Read an honest scoreboard.** A calibration curve answers "when the panel says 70, how often was it right?" Every statistic carries its denominator inline (for example "2 scored, 20 excluded by gateway filter"), and below the significance threshold the numbers render greyed as directional illustration, not significance-tested.

## Why the honesty is the product

The scoreboard aggregates only leak-safe, out-of-sample study rows. A live console run is recorded to the operator's history but can never enter the aggregate statistics, enforced as a data gate, not a convention. The pre-registered point (bar 0.6, horizon 3 days) is pinned; the moment a user slides off it, any out-of-sample claim locks into an explicit exploratory state. SHORT decisions on spot-only rTokens are shown as risk-managed advisory signals, never filled. Nothing is fabricated.

## Track fit

AI Trading Desk, Decision stress-testing sub-theme: the console presents the analysis and the operator makes the final call, and the conviction-gate slider is a literal decision stress-test over a stored ruling.
